title: Diagnostic Enzymes: ALT, AST, ALP, GGT, CK, LD and Amylase
summary: Tissue sources, isoenzymes and classic patterns of enzyme elevation used to localize organ injury.
objectives: Match each enzyme to its major tissue sources.
Use enzyme ratios and isoenzymes to localize injury (e.g., liver vs bone vs muscle).
Explain why GGT is used to confirm an ALP of hepatic origin.

highYield: ALT is more liver-specific than AST; AST also rises in myocardial and muscle injury.
ALP rises in both liver and bone disease — GGT confirms hepatic origin (GGT is not elevated in bone).
Lipase is more specific for acute pancreatitis than amylase and stays elevated longer.
quickReview.mnemonic: ALP up + GGT up = liver. ALP up + GGT normal = bone.

deepStudy.introduction: Enzymes are catalysts leaking from injured cells; their serum activity reflects tissue damage rather than organ function. Interpretation uses source specificity, time course and isoenzyme patterns.

sections.heading: Aminotransferases
sections.body: ALT (SGPT) is cytosolic and predominantly hepatic. AST (SGOT) has cytosolic and mitochondrial forms found in liver, myocardium and skeletal muscle. An AST:ALT > 2:1 suggests alcoholic liver disease; both markedly rise in viral hepatitis.

sections.heading: Cholestatic enzymes
sections.body: ALP is a group of isoenzymes; hepatic ALP rises with bile duct obstruction. GGT is induced by alcohol and drugs and is used to verify that an elevated ALP is hepatic rather than osseous.

sections.heading: Pancreatic and muscle enzymes
sections.body: Amylase rises within hours and normalizes in 3-5 days; lipase rises later but remains elevated 8-14 days and is more specific. CK-MB and troponin are preferred over LD1/LD2 (flipped pattern) for myocardial infarction in modern labs.

deepStudy.clinicalSignificance: Enzyme patterns guide the differential diagnosis of jaundice, chest pain and abdominal pain before imaging is available.
deepStudy.labInterpretation: Always report enzyme results with reference intervals that vary by method, age, sex and population; verify against your local laboratory.
examTraps: An elevated ALP alone does not prove liver disease — check GGT and consider bone sources (growth, Paget's, fractures).
Macroamylasemia causes high amylase with normal lipase and normal urine amylase.

memoryHooks.text: GGT = 'Good to Go with liver' — it confirms hepatic ALP.
memoryHooks.funny: Meow: 'GGT ang chaperone ng ALP. Pag wala si GGT, bone ang date ni ALP.'
